questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

The interview will be conducted **__by 9 a.m. till 11 a.m.__**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'from 9 a.m to 11 a.m'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m.'** should be used instead of **'by 9 a.m. till 11 a.m.'**
 
• ‘**From**’ is used to show the place, direction, or time that somebody/something starts or started.
 
 
• *Example: I work **from** 8.30 am **to** 5.00 pm every day.*
 
 
 
• Similarly, in the given sentence **9 a.m.** is the time when the interview started.
 
• '**From**' is followed by '**to**' when we talk about time.
 
• Hence, ‘**from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m.**’ is the most appropriate answer.

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The interview will be conducted **from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• इधर,** 'from 9 a.m. till 11 a.m.'** **'by 9 a.m. to 11 a.m' **के बजाय इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• '**From**' का प्रयोग उस स्थान, दिशा या समय को दर्शाने के लिए किया जाता है जिससे कोई व्यक्ति/कुछ शुरू होता है।
 
 
• Example: I work **from **8.30 am **to **5.00pm every day.
 
 
 
• इसी तरह दिए गए वाक्य में **9 a.m.** बजे वह समय है जब साक्षात्कार शुरू होगा।
 
• जब हम समय की बात करते हैं तो '**from**' के बाद '**to**' आता है।
 
• इसलिए, **'from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m.' **सबसे उपयुक्त उत्तर है।

questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

My brother said to me, "Have you read the newspaper today?"

options.text: My brother asked me if I had read the newspaper that day.
My brother asked me if you have read the newspaper today.
My brother asked me have you read the newspaper today.
My brother asked me if I had read the newspaper today.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'My brother asked me if I had read the newspaper that day.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the question, we have to change it into Indirect Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• In the given sentence the reporting verb has an object. Hence, 'said to' will be changed into 'asked'. 
 
• Comma and inverted commas will be removed. 
 
• The conjunction 'if' will be added.
 
• '**you**' will be changed into '**I**' because the** second-person** **pronouns** are changed according to the **object** of the **reporting** **verb**.
 
• **'have read'** will be changed into **'had read'.**
 
• The adverb '**today**' will be changed into **'that day'.**

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *My brother asked me if I had read the newspaper that day.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

• परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में **Reporting Verb** में **Object** है। इसलिए, **'said to' **को '**asked**' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• अल्पविराम और उल्टे अल्पविराम हटा दिए जाएंगे।
 
• **Conjunction** '**if**' जोड़ा जाएगा।
 
• '**you**' को '**I**' में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि **Reporting Verb** के **Object** के अनुसार **Second person** के **Pronoun** बदल दिए जाते हैं।
 
• **'have read' **को** 'had read'** में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• क्रिया विशेषण '**today**' को** 'that day' **में बदल दिया जाएगा।

questions.question: Ranjan in his ODI Cricket career, scored 15 runs on an average in 10 matches. If he scored 14 runs on an average in the first 4 matches and 12 runs on an average in the last 4 matches, then find the average of the runs scored by him in the remaining 2 matches.

⇒ average of runs in remaining 2 matches = 46 ÷ 2 = 23

questions.question: A boat can go 15 km downstream and 8 km upstream in 2 h. It can go 20 km downstream and 12 km upstream in 2 h 50 min. What is the speed (in km/h ) of the boat while going downstream?
questions.solution:
Given:

A boat can go 15 km downstream and 8 km upstream in 2 h. 

It can go 20 km downstream and 12 km upstream in 2 h 50 min.

Concept used:

While going downstream, the resultant speed is the sum of the speed of the boat in the still water and the flow of the water body. 

While going upstream, the resultant speed is the difference between the speed of the boat in still water and the flow of the water body.

Calculation:

Let the speed of the boat and the flow of the river be S and R kmph respectively.

Downstream speed = (S + R) kmph

Upstream speed = (S - R) kmph

Let 1/(S + R) = P and 1/(S - R) = Q.

According to the question,

15/(S + R) + 8/(S - R) = 2

⇒ 15P + 8Q = 2 ....(1)

20/(S + R) + 12/(S - R) = 17/6

⇒ 20P + 12Q = 17/6

⇒ 120P + 72Q = 17 ....(2)

Solving (1) and (2), we get

Q = 1/8 i.e. S - R = 8

P = 1/15 i.e. S + R = 15

**∴ The speed of the boat while going downstream is 15kmph.**

questions.question: What is the compound interest (in Rs.) on a sum of Rs. 46,000 for 2(2)/(5) years at 15% per annum, interest being compounded annually (nearest to a Rs.)?
questions.solution:
Given: 

Principal amount (P) = Rs. 46000

Rate (R) = 15%

Time (N) = 2(2)/(5) years

Concept used:

Compound interest, CI = P(1 + R/100)n - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

The principal amount becomes

⇒ 46000 × (1 + 15/100)² = Rs. 60835

Now, for 2/5 years, the rate of interest becomes = 15% × 2/5 = 6%

Hence, the principal amount becomes

⇒ 60835 × (1 + 6/100)¹ = Rs. 64485.1

So, the interest accrued = 64485.1 - 46000 ≈ Rs. 18485

**∴ Rs. 18485 is the compound interest on a sum of Rs. 46,000 for 2(2)/(5) years at 15% per annum, interest being compounded annually.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

For the first two years, the rate of interest is 15%

Then, for the next 2/5 years, the rate of interest becomes

⇒ 15% × 2/5 = 6%

So, calculating the successive percentage of 15%, 15% and 6%, we get

⇒ {(15 + 15 + 6) + (15 × 15 + 15 × 6 + 15 × 6)/100 + (15 × 15 × 6)/(100 × 100)}%

⇒ 40.185%

So, the interest accrued = 46000 × 40.185% ≈ Rs. 18485

∴ Rs. 18485 is the compound interest on a sum of Rs. 46,000 for years at 15% per annum, interest being compounded annually.

questions.question: Rain is liquid ______.
questions.solution:

• Precipitation occurs when a part of the atmosphere becomes saturated with water vapor (reaching 100% relative humidity), causing the water to condense and "precipitate" or fall off.
 
• Thus, fog and mist are not rain but colloid, because the water vapor is not condensed enough for precipitation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

• This is the reverse of evaporation, where liquid water becomes vapor.
 
• Condensation occurs in one of two ways: either the air cools to its dew point or it becomes so saturated with water vapor that it cannot hold any more water.
 
 
 
• **Sedimentation **is a physical water treatment process in which gravity is used to remove suspended solids from water.
 
 
• Solid particles trapped in a moving water disturbance can be naturally removed by sedimentation in the still waters of lakes and oceans.
 
• For example, in a mixture of sand and water, sand settles down at the bottom.
 
 
 
• **Decantation** is a process for the separation of mixtures of immiscible liquids or of a liquid and a solid mixture such as a suspension. 
 
 
• Example: decantation of oil and vinegar.

questions.question: ______ is an interpreted, high-level and general-purpose programming language.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Python**__.

__
 
• **Python is an interpreted, object-oriented, high-level programming language with dynamic semantics**__.

 __
 
• Its high-level data structure, coupled with dynamic typing and dynamic binding, make it very attractive for rapid application development as well as for use as a scripting or glue language for linking existing components together.
 
• Python's simple, easy-to-learn syntax emphasizes readability and therefore reduces program maintenance costs.
 
• Python supports modules and packages, which encourage program modularity and code reuse.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Different Types of Computer Language**

 
 
• **Machine Language**

 
 
• The machine language is sometimes referred to as machine code or object code which is set of binary digits 0 and 1. These binary digits are understood and read by a computer system and interpret easily.
 
• It is considered a native language as it can be directly understood by a central processing unit (CPU).
 
 
 
• **Assembly Language**
 
 
• The assembly language is considered a low-level language for microprocessors and many other programmable devices.
 
• The assembly language is also considered a second-generation language.
 
• The first generation language is machine language.
 
 
 
• **High-Level Language**
 
 
• The development of high-level language was done when the programmers face the issue in writing programs as the older language has portability issues which means the code written in one machine cannot be transferred to other machines.

• **The rebellion posed a great threat to British power in that region and was only contained with the defeat of the rebels at Gwalior on 20 June 1858**__.
 
• Its name has been contested and has been described as the **Sepoy Mutiny, the Indian Rebellion, the Great Rebellion, the Rebellion of 1857, the Indian Rebellion, and the First War of Independence**.

questions.question: ______ is a process of forming a thick oxide layer of aluminium.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Anodising**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anodising is the process of forming a thick oxide layer of aluminum**__.

 __
 
• The process is called anodizing because the part to be treated forms the anode electrode of an electrolytic cell.
 
• This aluminum oxide coat makes it resistant to further corrosion. 
 
• It is also useful in architectural finishing.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The ductility of steel varies depending on the types and levels of alloying elements present.
 
 
 
• **Galvanisation** or galvanization (or galvanizing as it is most commonly called) is the process of applying a protective zinc coating to iron or steel, to prevent rusting.
 
 
• The most common method is hot-dip galvanizing, in which steel sections are submerged in a bath of molten zinc.
 
 
 
• **Corrosion** is a natural process that converts a refined metal into a more chemically stable form such as oxide, hydroxide, carbonate, or sulfide.
 
 
• It is the gradual destruction of materials (usually a metal) by chemical or electrochemical reactions with their environment.

questions.question: In which of the following years did the Indian National Congress make the demand for a Constituent Assembly?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1934**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An idea for a Constituent Assembly was proposed in 1934 by **M. N. Roy**, a pioneer of the Communist movement in India and an advocate of radical democracy.
 
• It became an official demand of the Indian National Congress in **1935**, the Indian National Congress held its session at **Lucknow **in** April 1936** presided by** Pt. Jawahar Lal Nehru**. 
 
• With this, Congress added a new strand to its political engagement with the British on the future of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The official demand for Constituent Assembly was raised and the **Government of India Act, 1935** was **rejected **as it imposed the Constitution which was against the will of the Indians.
 
• **C. Rajagopalachari **voiced the demand for a Constituent Assembly on 1**5 November 1939** based on adult franchise and was accepted by the British in **August 1940**.
 
• On **8 August 1940**, a statement was made by **Viceroy Lord Linlithgow** about the expansion of the **Governor-General's Executive Council** and the establishment of a War Advisory Council.
 
• This offer, known as the **August Offer**, included giving full weight to minority opinions and allowing Indians to draft their own constitution.
 
• Under the** Cabinet Mission Plan of 1946**, **elections were held for the first time **for the Constituent Assembly.
 
• The Constitution of India was drafted by the Constituent Assembly, and it was implemented** under the Cabinet Mission Plan** on **16 May 1946**.
 
• The members of the Constituent Assembly were elected by the provincial assemblies by a single, transferable-vote system of proportional representation.
 
• The total membership of the Constituent Assembly was **389 **of which **292 **were representatives of the provinces, **93 **represented the princely states and four were from the chief commissioner provinces of Delhi, Ajmer-Merwara, Coorg, and British Baluchistan.

questions.question: For the residents of which of the following union territories PM Narendra Modi has launched Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojna (AB - PMJAY) ‘Sehat Scheme’ in December 2020?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir**__.

__
 
• **Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) SEHAT scheme:**

 
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) SEHAT scheme.
 
• The main aim behind the scheme is to extend health insurance coverage to all residents of **Jammu and Kashmir**__.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **About the AB-PMJAY Scheme**

 
 
• **SEHAT **stands for Social, Endeavour for Health and Telemedicine. It is a health insurance scheme for the Union Territory.
 
• It provides free-of-cost insurance cover to all the residents of the UT of J&K.
 
 
 
• Benefits:
 
 
• It also provides financial cover up to Rs.5 Lakh per family on a floater basis to all residents of the UT of J&K and an operational extension of PM-JAY to 15 lakh (approximately) additional families.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Important points about PM- JAY**

 
 
• It is the **world’s largest health insurance/assurance scheme** **fully financed by the government,** provides a cover of Rs 500,000 per family per year for **secondary **and **tertiary **care hospitalisation across public and private empanelled hospitals in India.
 
• The benefit of Rs 5,00,000 is on a family floater basis. This means that **it can be used by one or all members of the family.**
 
• It covers medical procedures including **oncology, cardiology, nephrolog**y, etc, and up to three days of pre-hospitalisation and 15 days post-hospitalisation expenses like diagnostics and medicines are also included in the scheme.
